shared_elements: animals stacked one above another in horizontal tiers
schematic outline animal bodies with stick-like legs
small round dots/depressions and short incised marks as filler
justification: Both surfaces depict schematic profile quadrupeds with rod-like legs stacked in superposed tiers facing the same direction, accompanied by small punctate marks and angular linear motifs, which is a real but fairly generic correspondence. A, however, presents a clearly ordered programme of distinct identifiable species (canid-like beasts, a long-necked bird, birds along a top register) with banded geometric friezes and human-limb-like elements, whereas B's figures are ambiguous, unregistered and scattered with cupmarks, so no distinctive shared motif or specific relationship (holding, flanking, enclosing) can be identified.
